story_text.value:
Hey HN! Recently Meta wrapped up their Global Developer Hackathon (https://dev.meta.ai/events/global-hackathon) which had a $1M prize pool (!!): 34K developers applied, 20K accepted, and over 5K projects were submitted.

With this crazy volume, it was infeasible to rank or even shortlist the best projects with human review. On the other hand, AI scoring against a rubric led to disappointing results.

In an effort to surface and spotlight the best projects, I built MetaArena (https://meta-hackathon.com/). It compares just two projects head-to-head, let's you pick which you thought was the stronger project, and places them on a leaderboard using the same algo platforms like LLMArena and DesignArena use to rank AI models (Bradley-Terry).

Check it out, at the very least I hope you find a cool project or two here that inspire you. Lmk if you have any feedback on the arena/leaderboard!

story_text.value:
MLK day got Trumped today so I spent the day hacking on a side project. The goal is to have agents simulate global health system activity and use patient (digital) twins to model care plans for people "like us" all over the world.

Creating Program: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIaJZ13A0UQ

I am working on each location right now trying to setup some RAG based on each region and/or public health system.

The "Hack" for the day was just to see if I could get agents speaking in FHIR to work w/ i18n translations.

German: https://gkv.dev - publishes programs to de.phm.ai

Canadian: https://ca.medicare.dev - publishes to ca.phm.ai

Australian: https://au.medicare.dev - publishes to au.phm.ai

USA: https://us.medicare.dev - publishes to us.phm.ai

Swiss: https://foph.dev - publishes to ch.phm.ai

UK: https://uk.nhs.dev - publishes to uk.phm.ai

Click the flag to make a program specific to that region.

Didn't make as much progress as I would like to have but learned a lot more about RAG and started learning about MCP so good day overall.

- Thx for your time. - ACH

raw.author: arionhardison
raw.story_text:
MLK day got Trumped today so I spent the day hacking on a side project. The goal is to have agents simulate global health system activity and use patient (digital) twins to model care plans for people "like us" all over the world.

Creating Program: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIaJZ13A0UQ

I am working on each location right now trying to setup some RAG based on each region and/or public health system.

The "Hack" for the day was just to see if I could get agents speaking in FHIR to work w/ i18n translations.

German: https://gkv.dev - publishes programs to de.phm.ai

Canadian: https://ca.medicare.dev - publishes to ca.phm.ai

Australian: https://au.medicare.dev - publishes to au.phm.ai

USA: https://us.medicare.dev - publishes to us.phm.ai

Swiss: https://foph.dev - publishes to ch.phm.ai

UK: https://uk.nhs.dev - publishes to uk.phm.ai

Click the flag to make a program specific to that region.

Didn't make as much progress as I would like to have but learned a lot more about RAG and started learning about MCP so good day overall.

- Thx for your time. - ACH
